# title | lines: speaker ~ chinese ~ english ;; …
# Target words are derived automatically from the text at build time.
# Written at HSK-3 level using words from this list. Pinyin is generated by
# scripts/build_data.py with the same lexicon the example sentences use.
Meeting someone|A~你好！你叫什么名字？~Hello! What is your name?;;B~我叫李明。你呢？~I'm Li Ming. And you?;;A~我姓张。很高兴认识你。~My surname is Zhang. Nice to meet you.
Ordering in a restaurant|A~服务员，请给我菜单。~Waiter, could I have the menu please?;;B~好的。您想喝点儿什么？~Certainly. What would you like to drink?;;A~一杯茶，谢谢。~A cup of tea, thank you.
Asking the way|A~请问，火车站怎么走？~Excuse me, how do I get to the train station?;;B~一直向前走，然后向左边。~Go straight ahead, then turn left.;;A~离这儿远吗？~Is it far from here?;;B~不远，走十分钟就到了。~Not far — ten minutes on foot.
Buying fruit|A~苹果多少钱一斤？~How much are the apples per jin?;;B~五块钱一斤，很便宜。~Five yuan a jin, very cheap.;;A~我买两斤，还要一些香蕉。~I'll take two jin, and some bananas as well.
Talking about the weather|A~今天天气怎么样？~What is the weather like today?;;B~很热，下午可能下雨。~Very hot; it may rain this afternoon.;;A~那我带伞去上班。~Then I'll take an umbrella to work.
At the doctor's|A~医生，我不舒服。~Doctor, I don't feel well.;;B~你发烧了吗？~Do you have a fever?;;A~有一点儿，我想我感冒了。~A little. I think I've caught a cold.;;B~多喝水，这个药一天吃三次。~Drink plenty of water; take this medicine three times a day.
Making plans for the weekend|A~这个周末你有什么安排？~What are your plans this weekend?;;B~我打算去爬山。你呢？~I'm planning to go hill-walking. And you?;;A~我要在家复习中文。~I'm going to stay home and revise Chinese.
On the phone|A~喂，你现在忙吗？~Hello, are you busy right now?;;B~有一点儿，怎么了？~A little. What is it?;;A~我一会儿给你打电话，好吗？~Shall I call you back in a moment?
In the classroom|A~老师，这个问题太难了。~Teacher, this question is too hard.;;B~别着急，我再讲一次。~Don't panic, I'll explain it once more.;;A~谢谢，现在我明白了。~Thank you — I understand now.
Shopping for clothes|A~这件衬衫我可以试试吗？~May I try this shirt on?;;B~当然可以。您穿多大的？~Of course. What size do you take?;;A~有点儿小，有大一点儿的吗？~It's a bit small — do you have a bigger one?
Taking the subway|A~去机场坐地铁方便吗？~Is the subway a convenient way to the airport?;;B~很方便，坐八站就到了。~Very — it's eight stops.;;A~要多长时间？~How long does it take?;;B~大概四十分钟。~About forty minutes.
At the bank|A~我想换点儿钱。~I'd like to change some money.;;B~好的，您带护照了吗？~Certainly. Do you have your passport with you?;;A~带了。我还需要办一张信用卡。~Yes. I also need to get a credit card.
Talking about family|A~你家有几口人？~How many people are there in your family?;;B~四口人：爸爸、妈妈、哥哥和我。~Four: dad, mum, my elder brother and me.;;A~你妹妹呢？~What about your younger sister?;;B~我没有妹妹。~I don't have a younger sister.
Being late|A~对不起，我迟到了。~Sorry I'm late.;;B~没关系，会议还没开始。~Never mind, the meeting hasn't started.;;A~路上车太多了。~There was too much traffic.
In a hotel|A~我要一个房间，住两天。~I'd like a room for two nights.;;B~好的，请给我看看您的护照。~Certainly. May I see your passport?;;A~房间里有空调吗？~Is there air conditioning in the room?
Ordering at the supermarket|A~超市里的水果新鲜吗？~Is the fruit in the supermarket fresh?;;B~很新鲜，我常常去买。~Very fresh — I buy it there often.;;A~牛奶和鸡蛋在哪儿？~Where are the milk and eggs?
Talking about study|A~你学习汉语多久了？~How long have you been studying Chinese?;;B~一年了，但是我的普通话还不太好。~A year, but my Mandarin still isn't very good.;;A~你说得很清楚，别担心。~You speak very clearly — don't worry.
Exercise and health|A~你每天都运动吗？~Do you exercise every day?;;B~我早上跑步，晚上打篮球。~I run in the morning and play basketball in the evening.;;A~难怪你身体这么健康。~No wonder you're so healthy.
At the airport|A~我们的航班几点起飞？~What time does our flight take off?;;B~下午三点。行李箱太重了。~Three in the afternoon. This suitcase is too heavy.;;A~我帮你拿吧。~Let me help you carry it.
Saying goodbye|A~我下个月要离开这儿了。~I'm leaving here next month.;;B~真的吗？我会想你的。~Really? I'll miss you.;;A~我们再见面的时候，我的汉语一定更好。~When we meet again my Chinese will definitely be better.
